## Step 1: Calculate the number of rocks Adam buys
Adam has $100 and each rock costs $5:
$$\text{Number of rocks} = \frac{\$100}{\$5} = 20 \text{ rocks}$$

## Step 2: Calculate the number of rocks sold (60%)
$$\text{Rocks sold} = 20 \times 0.60 = 12 \text{ rocks}$$

## Step 3: Calculate revenue from sales
$$\text{Revenue} = 12 \times \$7 = \$84$$

## Step 4: Calculate the loss
$$\text{Loss} = \text{Total investment} - \text{Revenue}$$
$$\text{Loss} = \$100 - \$84 = \$16$$

## Final Answer
